page_title: ShotMap — Turn each video into one storyboard

sources.entry: ShotMap - Turn videos into storyboard images with smart frame selection, manual refinement, and local PNG/JPG export. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ixiehao/ShotMap) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: ShotMap
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS app that turns videos into storyboard images made of selected frames, exported as PNG or JPG.
use_cases: Browse family recordings as a single image
Find the right clip among many travel videos
Review editing footage with a frame grid
Batch-create storyboards for a folder of videos
Make shareable PNG or JPG previews of videos
summary.what_it_does: ShotMap takes a video and lays out a grid of frames (from 3×3 up to 8×8) as a storyboard. It starts with automatic frame selection, which Smart Select can keep user-chosen frames and fill the remaining slots. The Manual Frame Editor and video timeline let users replace or step frames by 1 or 5 frames at a time. Storyboards can show filenames and timecodes, use the video's aspect ratio, and have a chosen background color. Multiple videos can be added at once, and the finished image is exported as PNG or JPG beside the source video or to a chosen location. The page states frame extraction and export run locally and videos are not uploaded.
notable: Automatic Smart Select plus manual frame editor with timeline and frame stepping
Local processing; videos are never uploaded
Interface available in seven languages, switchable without restart
Batch processing of multiple videos with pause option
caveats: Optional update check reads public GitHub release information
